∀ {k : Type u} {G : Type v} [inst : Field.{u} k] [IsAlgClosed.{u} k] [inst_2 : Group.{v} G] [inst_3 : Fintype.{v} G]
  [inst_4 : Invertible.{u} (Nat.cast.{u} (Fintype.card.{v} G))] (V W : FDRep.{u, v} k G)
  [CategoryTheory.Simple.{u, max (u + 1) v} V] [CategoryTheory.Simple.{u, max (u + 1) v} W],
  Eq.{u + 1}
    (HSMul.hSMul.{u, u, u} (Invertible.invOf.{u} (Nat.cast.{u} (Fintype.card.{v} G)))
      (Finset.sum.{v, u} Finset.univ.{v} fun g =>
        HMul.hMul.{u, u, u} (FDRep.character.{u, v} V g) (FDRep.character.{u, v} W (Inv.inv.{v} g))))
    (ite.{u + 1} (Nonempty.{u + 1} (CategoryTheory.Iso.{u, max (u + 1) v} V W)) 1 0)
